description: The top of the ladder: Glowmere over 1.21 square kilometres at glowmere-medium's per-square-metre density and species proportions. 1100 m is where the ladder stops being a ladder rather than where the machine stops coping -- past it the visible-instance count falls again (3,111 at 1100 m against 1,564 at 1200 m) because the composer's viewpoint lands on different ground, and Grass_Common_Short has already reached the composer's 120,000-instance ceiling for a foreground layer somewhere between 840 m and 1000 m, so the ground cover thins as the world grows. Both are measured in docs/renderer-2-benchmark-world.md. This rung hurts: read it as one fixed heavy scene to compare against itself, not as a point to interpolate through.
